hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i
J: iid Normal(0,1) on i<j, symmetric, zero diagonal, no Kac rescaling
primary: equal depth L versus QAOA p=L, fidelity of the energy-selected state
pagano_init: endpoint interpolation, linear at L=3, cubic after; L=2 also has an unconverted supplement-shaped start. Initialization only.

9.note: ten times coarser than the author step

12.note: nine fields; not the author step of 1e-4

coupled_gap_rule: minimum over the frozen grid of the gap to the first excited state whose spin-reflection parity, rounded to 5 decimals, equals the ground state's. Not E1-E0. Not used to drop instances.
